title_zh: 芬蘭 RCT：學校篩檢 + 10 週網上兒童焦慮 CBT，兩年後效果仍在
title_en: Internet CBT for child anxiety two-year RCT
summary_zh: 芬蘭圖爾庫大學透過學校健康篩檢，招募 465 名有焦慮症狀的 10–13 歲兒童進行隨機對照試驗。介入組接受 10 週網上認知行為治療「Master Your Worries」，包含兒童與家長模組及每週電話指導；焦慮症狀與功能改善均優於對照組，效果在 6 至 12 個月間更明顯，並延續至兩年追蹤，症狀較重者獲益最大。研究刊於《JAMA Network Open》。
summary_en: A University of Turku RCT of 465 school-screened Finnish children aged 10–13 found a 10-week guided internet CBT programme with parent involvement and weekly phone coaching reduced anxiety and improved functioning, with effects lasting two years (JAMA Network Open).
evidence_note: 隨機對照試驗（新聞稿轉述，刊於 JAMA Network Open）。

posts.title: Finnish intervention program reduces children's anxiety and improves functional ability — effects are still evident after two years
posts.content: 芬蘭圖爾庫大學的隨機對照試驗，以學校健康篩檢找出 465 名 10–13 歲有焦慮症狀的兒童，10 週網上 CBT 課程「Master Your Worries」加家長參與與每週電話指導，兩年後效果仍在，刊於 JAMA Network Open。

related.title_zh: 港大防自殺中心：學童自殺不能只歸咎「適應期」，前線守門員要補位
related.title_en: HKU CSRP: student suicides not explained by adjustment period
related.summary_zh: 港大香港賽馬會防止自殺研究中心高級培訓顧問張鳳儀接受東網訪問時指出，開學「適應期」可能帶來壓力，但不能充分解釋學童自殺；自殺通常由多重因素造成，約三成自殺離世學生生前曾被診斷有精神健康問題或有相關醫療服務紀錄。她建議加強前線教師的精神健康及防止自殺培訓、重視教師身心健康、建立人人都是「守門員」的文化，並加強家校合作。
related.summary_en: A senior training consultant at HKU's Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention told on.cc that the school 'adjustment period' cannot fully explain student suicides; about 30% of students who died by suicide had prior mental health diagnoses or service records. She urged gatekeeper training for teachers, attention to teacher wellbeing, and stronger home–school partnership.

related.title_zh: 港大賽馬會 ADHD 支援計劃：全校三層模式，已培訓逾 6,000 名學生
related.title_en: HKU JCKAK whole-school 3-tier ADHD support framework
related.summary_zh: 香港大學心理學系介紹「Jockey Club Keen and Active Kids Project（JCKAK）」：由 Kathy Shum 教授團隊主導、香港賽馬會慈善信託基金資助，自 2019 年起與教育局及五間非政府機構合作，在主流中小學以全校三層介入模式支援 ADHD 學生。計劃已為逾 6,000 名學生提供實證為本訓練、裝備逾 4,000 名教育工作者，並以工作坊支援 1,500 名家長，另有數碼工具與手冊。
related.summary_en: HKU Psychology describes JCKAK, a Jockey Club–funded ADHD support project led by Prof. Kathy Shum's team since 2019 with the Education Bureau and five NGOs. Using a whole-school 3-tier model, it has trained over 6,000 students and 4,000 educators and supported 1,500 parents.

related.title_zh: 台灣兒少心智病房延宕，年底先開北中部 21 床
related.title_en: Taiwan youth psychiatric crisis wards to open 21 beds
related.summary_zh: 聯合報報導，衛福部規劃的兒少心智專責病房原訂 2025 年底在台大醫院、台中榮總完成建置，但因空間改建、消防安全及硬體設備問題延宕，目前仍未有病床啟用。心理健康司司長陳柏熹表示，預計今年底先啟用北部、中部共 21 床，南部其餘 9 床仍在採購；病房以 18 歲以下、家庭學校與一般門診已難處理的急迫危機個案為主要收治對象。
related.summary_en: Taiwan's planned child and adolescent psychiatric crisis wards were delayed by renovation, fire-safety and equipment problems. The Department of Mental Health says 21 beds in the north and centre should open by end-2026, with 9 southern beds still in procurement.
